title: Add Expense Agent consumption V2 and trial support
summary: Expense Agent now supports consumption V2 API, a 50-expense trial quota, improved telemetry with static messages and model metadata dimensions, and an internal quota interface for extensibility.
key_points: Adds V2 consumption API with nested v1 field validation
Implements 50-expense feature trial with trial status display
Policy-evaluation operations excluded from trial usage counting
Internal quota interface enables test injection and production routing
Replaces raw telemetry with static messages and PascalCase metadata dimensions
quote: Add the Expense Agent V2 consumption API and a 50-expense feature trial.
